title: A — Current awake model
description: Current 0.5.4 adult background: same seed, 180 s. Existing two-level muscle gate and spatial field.

title: B — Graded awake / same regional weights
description: Offline alternative: continuous positive, irregular multiscale envelope replaces only the current two-level gate, preserving the same carrier and remaining channel/time gains. Mean T3 component RMS matched to A.

title: C — Independent regional muscle activity
description: Offline alternative: independently varying left/right temporalis, frontal and posterior/nuchal proxy sources; 25% within-source shared variance. Candidate weights are authored, not measured clinical coefficients. T3 RMS matched to A.

title: D — Burst suppression / default reactivity present
description: Diagnostic control: authored BS pattern with reactivity changed to present, reproducing the guided-builder muscle eligibility. No seizure or explicit artifact. Tonic EMG grows with burst envelope.

title: E — Same burst suppression / tonic muscle removed
description: Exact paired offline subtraction of the generated tonic component from D, after current calibration. All cerebral burst content retained. A candidate for the currently intended non-myoclonic teaching examples, not a universal clinical BS rule.

title: F — Current authored unreactive BS control
description: Existing catalog configuration with absent reactivity already emits zero tonic EMG. Remaining fast activity is not evidence of muscle by itself. Separate calibration means F is not a pixel-matched counterpart to D/E.
